This parameter is used to identify merge keys for type mismatch checks and is passed to the warehouse ingestion utility. This supports warehouse-source reliability by potentially preserving identity or partitioning metadata during schema

observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion and warehouse-query compatibility. This could help warehouse-source reliability and query correctness.
